description: A physical location or site belonging to an operator, with its own timezone, address, and Google Drive integration.
A staff member employed at a branch, tracking employment status, payroll basis, visa details, face enrollment, and timeclock data.
An organisational unit grouping employees within a tenant, assignable to one or more branches.
A job role or position title (e.g. Receptionist, Nanny) used for scheduling, staffing requirements, and employee assignments.
Metadata record for files uploaded to object storage, tracking the storage key, MIME type, size, and source system.
HTML document templates (employment contracts, letters, etc.) with merge field support, versioning, and bilingual body content.
System login accounts with RBAC roles (global_admin through staff), phone OTP support, and optional link to an employee record.
Express session store table managed by connect-pg-simple, holding serialised session data and expiry timestamps.
Key-value store for global application configuration settings (e.g. feature flags, system-wide defaults).
Top-level multi-tenancy root; every other record in the system belongs to a tenant identified by a unique slug.
An organisation or business entity within a tenant that groups branches and scopes operator_admin users.
Identity anchor for both employees and advisors, holding contact info, timeclock PIN, phone verification, and access policy link.
Generated payslip records for each employee per payroll run, storing the full slip data as JSON and an optional PDF URL.
An individual shift slot at a branch and department with a start/end time, optionally assigned to an employee or left open for coverage.
Controls which branches a user can access, supporting either all-branches scope or a specific selected branch.
Raw clock-in/clock-out events captured at kiosk devices via face recognition or PIN, with confidence scores and photo evidence.
Junction table assigning job roles to employees, with a proficiency level and a flag for the primary role.
Tenant-specific public holiday calendar used in payroll calculations and scheduling to identify non-working days.
A named shift row in a weekly schedule (e.g. Morning Shift 09:00–17:00) with staffing requirements, break config, and optional department/group.
Assigns an employee or casual worker to a specific shift row on a specific date within a weekly plan, supporting cross-branch borrowing.
A named duty or task block assigned to an employee within a shift, specifying a sub-period time range and duty type.
A temporary or contract worker with a fixed engagement period and daily rate, schedulable alongside regular employees.
Leave records for employees (annual, sick, unpaid, etc.) with full-day or half-day support, used in scheduling and payroll.
The container for a branch's weekly schedule, anchored to a Monday start date and holding shift rows and assignments.
A named grouping of shift rows within a branch schedule (e.g. Team A, Team B) for visual organisation in the scheduling UI.
Individual earnings, deductions, and statutory contribution line items for an employee within a payroll run.
Rolled-up payroll totals per employee per run: gross pay, deductions, net pay, and employer cost.
Defines a person's access level, permitted modules, and branch scope, including Core system account provisioning status.
Live clock-in state per employee: whether currently clocked in, at which branch, and timestamps of last clock event.
A single payroll calculation run within a period, progressing through DRAFT to FINALIZED, containing all line items and summaries.
A registered tablet or kiosk device at a branch used for face-recognition clock-in or reception check-ins.
Calendar events for a branch such as closures, special openings, or internal events, shown in scheduling views.
Many-to-many junction linking departments to the branches they operate within.
Junction table specifying which job roles are required or eligible for a given schedule shift row.
Auto-generated or manual break slots for each employee assignment within a shift, with staggered timing to avoid coverage gaps.
A payroll period (monthly or otherwise) for an operator, defining the date range and status lifecycle from DRAFT to FINALIZED.
Per-employee per-day reconciliation of scheduled vs actual worked minutes and pay within a payroll run, flagging variances.
Encrypted credential vault entries (passwords, PINs, accounts) with branch-level visibility and access controls.
OAuth tokens for the Xero accounting integration, storing access/refresh tokens and the connected Xero organisation.
Links document templates to specific branches, with an optional flag marking one as the branch default.
Splits an employee's salary cost across branches by percentage for multi-branch cost allocation reporting.
A generated employment contract for an employee, holding the rendered HTML snapshot, merge data, signing status, and PDF path.
Audit trail of system events (contract sent, employee onboarded, etc.) linked to branches, employees, and contracts.
Automatically detected issues requiring manager action (expiring visas, unsigned contracts, missing documents), with severity and resolution tracking.
One-time-use token sessions for employee face enrollment at a kiosk, with expiry and usage tracking.
Derived daily timekeeping records pairing scheduled hours with actual clock-in/out times, pending manager approval.
Flagged timekeeping anomalies (missed clock-out, late arrival, PIN usage) requiring manager review and resolution.
Audit log of SMS OTP authentication events (sent, verified, failed) for password reset and phone verification flows.
Specifies which job roles are required to fill an open shift slot.
Configures how annual leave is accrued at a branch, defining how many days off are earned per days worked.
A saved schedule template for a branch that can be applied to future weeks, optionally sourced from an existing week plan.
A shift row definition within a schedule template, mirroring scheduleShiftRows but not tied to a specific week.
Junction table linking required job roles to a schedule template row.
Audit trail of bulk scheduling actions (template applied, week cleared, department overwritten) with before-state snapshots.
Payroll anomalies and warnings raised during a run (missing clock-out, negative pay, etc.) requiring review or approval before finalisation.
Salary advance loans issued to employees, with repayment schedule configuration and outstanding balance tracking.
Individual repayment instalments deducted from payroll runs against a salary advance, tracking the balance after each deduction.
Country-specific statutory payroll rules (SSO, income tax brackets, etc.) stored as versioned JSON configurations with effective date ranges.
Computed statutory contribution results (SSO, tax) per employee per payroll run, stored as a JSON breakdown for auditing.
Named categories of duties (e.g. Reception, Pool Watch) that can be assigned as duty blocks within shifts.
Per-user overrides for module access (core, hr, studio, etc.) that supersede the branch-level defaults.
Short-lived hashed pairing codes (120s TTL) used to activate and register a new kiosk device at a branch.
Audit history of employee record changes (salary, branch, department, title) storing before and after values with effective dates.
Company or branch-specific policy documents (HR policies, SOPs) in HTML or PDF, versioned and publishable to employees.
Uploaded files attached to an employee record (ID card, passport, resignation form, etc.) with type classification.
Records the offboarding details for a resigning or terminated employee, including reason, last working day, and outstanding leave balances.
HR letters issued to employees (warning letters, confirmation of employment, etc.) with e-signature support and PDF generation.
Master catalogue of asset types (uniform, equipment, tools) that can be issued to employees.
Tracks assets issued to individual employees, including quantity, serial number, return requirements, and return status.
Task checklist items for an employee offboarding process (return assets, revoke access, etc.) with completion tracking.
Authenticated session tokens for kiosk devices, allowing them to make API calls without re-pairing.
Log of all clock-in authentication attempts at kiosks (face or PIN), recording outcomes, confidence scores, and failure reasons for security auditing.
Sliding-window rate limit counters for authentication endpoints, keyed by phone number or IP address to prevent brute force attacks.
HMAC-signed one-time password reset tokens tied to a user or person, with expiry and used-flag to prevent replay.
Junction table associating job roles with the departments they belong to.
Junction table making a job role available at specific branches, controlling which roles appear in scheduling at each location.
Minimum staffing rules for a branch and department by day type (weekday, weekend, public holiday), used to validate scheduling.
Configures the annual sick leave entitlement per branch, with optional pro-rating by employee start date.
Pre-assigns an employee to a specific day-of-week within a schedule template row, so they are auto-filled when the template is applied.
Records an employee's regular day off within a schedule template, so they are automatically excluded when the template is applied.
Payroll configuration per employee: salary, bank account, tax ID, SSO number, and statutory deduction settings.
Manager-requested corrections to an employee's timekeeping for a given work date, with before/after snapshots and approval workflow.
Approval or rejection decisions recorded against a payroll exception by the required approver role.
Per-operator payroll policy configuration: variance thresholds, overtime approval requirements, rounding rules, and break deduction defaults.
Audit log recording every time a user views a decrypted credential in the access vault.
Log of each Xero data synchronisation run, recording type, date range, and success or error status.
Cached Xero tracking categories (cost centres, departments) synced from Xero for mapping payroll data.
Cached Xero tracking options (individual values within a tracking category, e.g. specific branch names) synced from Xero.
Raw P&L and other financial reports pulled from Xero and stored as JSON for local processing and analytics.
Normalised P&L line-item facts derived from raw Xero reports, broken down by section, line name, and location for analytics.
Individual bank transactions synced from Xero, stored with direction (in/out) and raw JSON for cash flow analysis.
Daily cash flow summary aggregated from bank transactions, showing total in, out, and net per day per tenant.
